NONE: › a stick with soft material attached to one end, especially used for washing floors
拖把；洗碗刷
› to use a mop to wash something
用拖把拖洗
› to use a cloth to remove sweat from the face
擦去（臉上的）汗水

example: a floor mop
地板拖把
a dish mop
洗碗刷
He mopped the bathroom floor.
他拖了浴室地板。
He kept pausing to mop his brow.
他不斷停下來擦去額頭的汗水。

NONE: › to use a piece of cloth or a mop to remove liquid from the surface of something
（用布或拖把）吸乾淨；用拖把擦去
› informal to finish dealing with something
結束，完成

example: There's milk on the floor over there - could you get a cloth and mop it up?
那邊地板上有牛奶——你能拿塊布把它擦乾淨嗎？
It took a week to mop up the last of the enemy soldiers (= defeat them).
徹底消滅敵軍殘部花了一個星期。

NONE: › to be unhappy and unwilling to think or act in a positive way, especially because of a disappointment
（尤指因失望而）悶悶不樂，自怨自艾

example: There's no point in sitting at home and moping - get out there and find yourself another job!
坐在家裡自怨自艾有甚麼用——走出去再找份工作吧！

NONE: › to move from one place to another without any particular purpose or energy, because you are unhappy or disappointed
（在…）沒精打埰地閒逛

example: He was driving me crazy, moping around the house all day.
他整天在房子裡無精打采地走來走去，快把我弄瘋了。

NONE: › a small motorcycle with pedals (= parts that you press with your feet to move forward) that can be used when starting it or travelling up a hill
機器腳踏車，機動腳踏兩用車

C: › a type of Australian and New Zealand owl whose call sounds like its name
› Australian English informal someone who is stupid or looks very unhappy

NONE: › an attractive young child, especially a girl
寶貝，心肝（尤指對小女孩的愛稱）

example: a curly-haired moppet
鬈頭髮的小寶貝

NONE: › the activity of dealing with a small number of people, problems, etc. that remain after most of them have been defeated or solved
清理；掃尾

example: The war was effectively over, although skirmishing and mopping-up went on for some time.
戰爭實際上結束了，不過一些小衝突和清理行動還持續了一段時間。
